hero.name: Viktor Vedmich
hero.lede: I design cloud architecture for enterprise teams at AWS. Here I write about Kubernetes and AI agents in production, share my talks and slides, and host two podcasts.

podcasts.title: Podcasts
podcasts.dkt_desc: A podcast and community about DevOps, SRE, AI, system design and cloud. Interviews with engineers, mock interviews, and news that listeners send in. I host it with Alexander Dovnar.
podcasts.aws_desc: A Russian-language podcast about AWS services, architecture patterns, AI applications and IT careers. I have hosted it since 2021, so you hear the view from inside AWS.
